controller_resources.memory_peak_scope: whole original controller service lifetime, including earlier preparation and previous phases; never a memory delta or per-actor peak
controller_resources.scope: whole original controller cgroup and all descendants; includes controller, broker, launcher and external producer processes; excludes separately systemd-owned public phase; not per-actor RSS
